info.title: GSharp cs2gs C# to G# translator
info.description: Command-line tool (`cs2gs`) that translates C# source to GSharp. Requires a .NET 10 runtime.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: cs2gs - C# to G# migration tool (ADR-0115

options.name: --app
options.description: Migrate only this app (repeatable, e.g. corpus/L1-Console).

options.name: --out
options.description:
Runs root for artifacts (default: ./cs2gs-runs).
Output directory for report.html + summary.json (default: the run dir).
A migrate run also writes report.html + summary.json into the run dir automatically (ADR-0115 §F).
Exit code is non-zero if any app fails a stage (so CI can gate).

options.name: --config
options.description: Build config used to find gsc (default: Release).
